set.body: M2/M3 of docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md. Deliver every required row in docs/EYESIM_CAPABILITIES.md through public APIs. Reuse x-contrast, surface-totality, temporal-selector, surface-decomposition, and facade work. Prove three journeys: existing fixations to matched/control contrast; raw recording to AOI results; multiscale and temporal repetition analysis. Provide template feature construction and a basic training-only fit via an optional adapter or executable export/reimport route. Preserve rows, keys, failures, denominators and fitted-model scope. Exit: pinned scientific cases and runnable guides pass on supported runtimes, with no unresolved required capability gaps.
set.title: Complete the eyesim baseline through coherent public workflows
